title: i18n phase 3 (platform metadata and built-in emails): extraction and bundle checks read PLATFORM_LOCALES; backfill the seven missing locales
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ③ a split of tracking card #29428 (ruling F of #29349), which `domain:spec#2` asked for (6659592659). Phase 1, #30001, landed in PR #30007, so `@objectstack/spec/system` now exports `PLATFORM_LOCALES`, `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`, `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES` and `platformLocaleTagOf`. Nothing reads them yet. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #29428

## Wanted

- `i18n:extract --locales` and `scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` read `PLATFORM_LOCALES`, so a missing locale in any `translations/` package turns the existing bundle check red. ⛔ No new gate (ruling F).
- Backfill the seven locales missing from every `translations/` package: one PR per package, AI-written, at the same quality bar as #17508 (precedent PR #19345). Do the same for the 8 built-in email templates.
- `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_FLOOR_LOCALE = 'en-US'` against the table's `en` is a protocol change. Decide it in its own PR, with an alias, as #29428 says.

Reader: `domain:server` (the `translations/` packages, the email templates, `i18n:extract`). This card holds the list of per-package PRs; tick each package as it lands.

## Per-package PRs (kept by `domain:server#2`)

Locales added under the table tags: `zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ko`. One PR per package, landed in sequence on the card thread's branch; `platform-objects` splits into seven PRs, one per locale.

- [x] `service-realtime` — PR #30536 (merged 2026-11-05)
- [x] `plugin-webhooks` — PR #30586 (merged 2026-11-05)
- [x] `service-storage` — PR #30649 (merged 2026-11-05)
- [x] `service-mailbox` — PR #30606 (merged 2026-11-05)
- [x] `service-messaging` (with its hand-written `messages.ts` records) — PRs #30638 + #30673 (merged 2026-11-05)
- [x] `plugin-audit` — PR #30625 (merged 2026-11-05)
- [ ] `plugin-approvals` (with its hand-written records; after #30208 lands)
- [x] `plugin-security` — PR #30744 (merged 2026-11-06)
- [x] `plugin-sharing` (with `SysQueue`, `SysQueueMember`) — PR #30767 (merged 2026-11-06)
- [ ] `service-settings` (after #30446 lands; its coverage test reads `PLATFORM_LOCALES` in the last PR)
- [ ] `platform-objects` (7 PRs, one per locale)
- [ ] last PR: `i18n:extract --locales` and `check-i18n-bundles.mjs` read `PLATFORM_LOCALES` (`Fixes`)
- [ ] out of this thread: the 8 built-in email templates and `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_FLOOR_LOCALE`
